title: PaymentSchedulerResponse
description: Standard scheduler response: the resource plus its server-managed state.

PaymentScheduler.description:
Scheduler attached to an active PayTo payment agreement. On create/amend, status accepts ACTIVE or INACTIVE only;
other lifecycle states (PAUSED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED) may appear on read responses.

paymentAgreementId.description: The payment agreement the scheduler is attached to.

status.description: Scheduler state. Create/amend accept ACTIVE or INACTIVE only.

frequency.description: Run frequency. Must match the underlying agreement's frequency.

amount.description: Run amount in AUD as a string. Must fit inside the agreement's per-payment and per-period caps.

startDate.description: First run date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be strictly after today in the scheduler's timezone.

endDate.description: Last permitted run date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for an open-ended scheduler; send null to clear on amend.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. Australia/Sydney, Australia/Perth, UTC). No implicit default.

version.description: Version required when updating this scheduler

PaymentSchedulerStatus.description: Server-managed state returned on every GET/POST response.

version.description: Monotonically incrementing version, updated on each successful mutation.

lastRunDatetime.description: Datetime of the most recent recorded run, if any (ISO 8601 UTC, millisecond precision).

updatedDatetime.description: Timestamp of the most recent amendment, if any (ISO 8601 UTC).
